title: Emerging-cluster callouts
description:
Show "what the graph noticed": clusters that are new, growing or cooling. Uses cluster identity across topic-model runs from Biblicus (blbs-846d62) and weekly bins (blbs-7d8c88). Only clusters the desk accepted as a steering proposal are named and shown; unaccepted clusters appear as "unnamed, n items" or are hidden (editor choice). State labels are never claimed with fewer than 4 weeks of data. At launch show accepted proposals, not raw clusters.

Weekly modelling runs on a worker (a developer workstation for now; see Biblicus cloud job runner blbs-9668cf for the later automated path). Parent initiative: PPY-428252.
